userStories.title: Implement Genetic Backtesting Engine
userStories.description: Create a new endpoint `/backtest` in cloud_api.py that allows the Supervisor to request a simulation of current DNA against historical data (last 24h) to validate mutations BEFORE they are applied to the live account.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs NomadBrain.scan_market logic on historical candles
Returns total PnL and Win Rate
